column_description: The type of disease studied by the project; e.g. Sarcoma,  Breast Invasive Carcinoma,Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia, etc
Associated entity type, eg   aliquot   or   case
Program dbGaP accession number, eg phs000189
GDC unique identifier

Unique GDC identifier for this file (corresponds to the file_barcode)  --  this can be used to access more information from the GDC data portal like this: https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/files/c21b332c-06c6-4403-9032-f91c8f407ba5
Project name abbreviation; the program name appended with a project name abbreviation; eg. TCGA-OV, etc.
Referring to the default/main database at the GDC. In this table, this field is always legacy.
Platform used to generate this data, eg  Illumina  , or  Affymetrix SNP 6.11
Where available, size of the index file in bytes
Type of metadata file, eg mage-tab
GDC case uuid for associated case(s)
Where available, GDC file uuid for index file
GDC file identifier. This is a duplicate of file_gdc_id field found in some tables.
Name of GDC metadata file
Experimental strategy used to generate data (where applicable) e.g. WXS, RNA-Seq
GDC entity uuid for associated entity(ies)
File format of the underlying data, eg BCR XML, BAM
GDC archive UUID
Original submitter file ID (eg CGHub analysis_id)
Archive state
File state -- either live or submitted
Where available, GDC file name for index file
TCGA codes for the Professional Organization or Group (Center) which has submitted the data, more info: https://gdc.cancer.gov/resources-TCGA-users/TCGA-code-tables/center-codes
Project Name; frequently the same as or similar to the project disease type eg   Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia - Phase II   or   Breast Invasive Carcinoma   etc
One of CGC, GSC, BCR, COM (or null)
Center name, eg BCM, BI, WUGSC
Timestamp of creation, eg 2016-10-27T21:58:12.297090-05:11
Program dbGaP accession number, eg phs000178
The size of the file measured in bytes
File Type  -- eg aligned_reads, simple_somatic_mutation, gene_expression, etc
Semicolon-delimited list of file tags, eg  coverage  , or  hg19;nocnv  , etc
Program name, eg TCGA or TARGET
Submitter id for associated entity(ies)
Category description of the underlying data, eg Clinical, Raw Sequencing Data, Simple Nucleotide Variation, Transcriptome Profiling  , etc
Md5sum for GDC data file
Original archive sumbitter name, eg  nationwidechildrens.org_BRCA.bio.Level_1.56
Size of metadata file
Data accessibility policy (open or controlled)
Center abbreviation, eg WUSM
Archive revision number
Access Control List -- if access is controlled, this field contains the dbGaP accession, eg phs000179
Name of file at the GDC
Experimental source of the data type, eg Tissue slide image, RNA-Seq
Timestamp of latest update, eg 2017-03-04T16:37:26.081298-06:00
GDC file UUID for metadata (eg mage-tab) file
